course.title: Transportation Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: It is surveyed that people of Dhaka city value transit time twice as much as (07) walking time. For planned BRT line 1 of Dhaka city it is also found that the walking speed of the people is 4 kph; Dwell time lost at each station is 30 seconds; Crossing volume is 7000 passengers/hr; Peak Hour Unidirectional maximum demand is 9000 passengers/hr; Bi-directional density of passengers boarding and alighting near a specific point is 2500 passengers/kph. Find out the optimum distance between the stations of BRT line 1.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2014
